laat_vaar.voor: aarde se middel, ewe ver van albei pole
laat_vaar.na: aarde se middel, ewe ver van albei pole af
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The circumposition 'van ... af' is the natural form with 'ewe ver', and the study text already uses it, so the glossary should match.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'ewe ver van albei pole' is standard Afrikaans without 'af', so adding it to a glossary definition is a lateral move on wording that changes only through the writer.
